product_desc: The Acer One 14 Z8-415 is a laptop designed for professionals and students, featuring a 14-inch Full HD display, an 11th Gen Intel Core processor, 8GB of RAM, and a 512GB SSD. It is a lightweight and portable device, weighing 1.5 kg, and comes with Windows 11 Home pre-installed.

product_features.Processor: 11th Gen Intel Core i3 1115G4 or i5.
product_features.Accessories Included: Laptop, Power Adaptor, User Guide, Warranty Documents.
